subject: Simple relation conditions
notes: kb/Work PB1468 LANDED (wave 67 N). Item 6 'Two operands where one is a numeric integer and the other is class alphanumeric or national' (cite.py OK) bounded by §8.8.4.2.5 'The numeric integer operand shall be an integer literal or an integer numeric data item of usage display or national' (cite.py OK). The ONE comparability table RelationComparability.Breach, asked at the ONE relation checkpoint (StatementValidation.CheckRelationalOperands -> CheckGeneralRelationComparability, so IF / EVALUATE pairs and ranges / PERFORM UNTIL / SEARCH WHEN / abbreviated relations inherit it), refuses a non-integer, COMP, COMP-3, FLOAT-LONG item, a non-integer literal, an arithmetic expression or a NUMERIC function against an alphanumeric / alphabetic / national operand: COBOL2532 (error; --permissive warning, DA6 disposition; docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-RELCLASS). Measured on the w67n build: `IF N1 = X4` (9(3)V9), `IF NC = XC` (COMP), `IF X4 = NI + 1`, `IF X4 = 1.5` each COBOL2532 (were clean, N1=X4 and NC=XC ran Y). Defined pairs unchanged and pinned by 85/pb1468_relation_defined_pairs (ND=XA EQ, signed NS=XA EQ, XE<ND LT, literal 12=XA NE, ND=SPACE NE). A numeric, integer or index FUNCTION-IDENTIFIER is NOT the integer operand (kb/Work PB3691, owner 2026-10-25, "Refuse it per the spec"): 8.8.4.2.5 admits only 'an integer literal or an integer numeric data item of usage display or national' (cite.py OK), a function-identifier references a data item (8.4.3.2.1, cite.py OK; the folded FUNCTION LENGTH is that function, never a literal) and 15.2 4), 5), 6) (cite.py OK) state no usage for the item it returns, so RelationComparability.IsNumericIntegerOperand asks the one reader STRING SR1 and INSPECT SR2 ask (IntrinsicArgumentRules.FunctionIsNotDisplayOrNational; docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-FNUSE) and `IF FUNCTION INTEGER(N) = "0007"`, the folded `FUNCTION LENGTH(N) = "4"`, the EVALUATE / SEARCH WHEN / PERFORM UNTIL / abbreviated forms and the national forms are COBOL2532 in either operand order (measured on the PB3691 build; before it the INTEGER function compiled and answered not equal for N = 7 against "0007"). An alphanumeric or national function, and a numeric function against a numeric operand, stay defined (pb3691_relation_function_operands, pb3691_relation_national_function_controls). Sibling arm: the EVALUATE THROUGH lowering BoundRangeMembership (IN alphabet-name / EC-RANGE-INVALID checking) is built by ConditionBinder.CheckedRangeMembership through the same checkpoint; a multiply-read EVALUATE subject is screened as WRITTEN (ConditionBinder.RecordIntermediate), not as its implementor intermediate.
